brief:
Palestinians and Israelis expressed sharply different reactions to the Democratic Party's success in the US midterm elections, according to Al Jazeera English. The outcome prompted competing assessments from both communities about implications for Middle East policy and Palestinian-Israeli affairs under continued Democratic control.

The division reflected broader disagreements over how a Democratic-led Congress might approach Israeli-Palestinian issues, with responses hinging on each side's expectations for US support and diplomatic direction in coming months.
dek: Palestinians and Israelis are divided in their opinion following the win by Democrats in the US midterm elections.
title: Democrats' midterm victory divides Palestinians and Israelis
